description:
Open the TitanicSurvival dataset ('/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicSurvival.csv'). Perform a Chi-Square Test of Independence to analyze the relationship between 'passengerClass' (Rows) and 'survived' (Columns). Crucially, you must stratify the analysis by 'sex' using the 'Layers' option to see separate results for Females and Males. Save the project as 'TitanicStratified.omv' in the Documents/Jamovi folder. Finally, create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/stratified_results.txt' containing the Chi-Square statistic and p-value for each gender group in the following format:

Female_X2=<value>
Female_p=<value>
Male_X2=<value>
Male_p=<value>
